```yaml
name: Aliyun Docker Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        architecture: [amd64, arm64]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up QEMU for cross-platform builds
      uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v2

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2

    - name: Login to Aliyun Container Registry
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        registry: registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com
        username: ${{ secrets.ALIYUN_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.ALIYUN_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}

    - name: Build and push Docker image
      run: |
        docker buildx build --platform linux/${{ matrix.architecture }} -t registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp:${{ github.sha }}-${{ matrix.architecture }} --push .
```

This workflow will allow you to manually trigger it from the GitHub Actions page, build Docker images for both AMD64 and ARM64 architectures, and push them to your specified Aliyun Container Registry. Make sure to add the required secrets (`ALIYUN_REGISTRY_USERNAME` and `ALIYUN_REGISTRY_PASSWORD`) in your repository settings under "Secrets".
